import APPTReview.FixedLocalLimit
import Mathlib.Analysis.Matrix.Order
import Mathlib.Topology.Order.Compact

open scoped BigOperators ComplexOrder
open Matrix
namespace APPTReview
variable {a b : Type*} [Fintype a] [Fintype b] [DecidableEq a] [DecidableEq b]

/-- Continuity uses the actual partial transpose, a permutation of matrix entries. -/
theorem continuous_partialTranspose : Continuous
    (APPT.Quantum.partialTranspose : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ → Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ) := by
  unfold APPT.Quantum.partialTranspose
  fun_prop

/-- An arbitrary (not finite or sampled) intersection of physical unitary tests is closed. -/
theorem isClosed_absolutelyPPT : IsClosed
    {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ | APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT A} := by
  have he : {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ | APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT A} =
      ⋂ U : Matrix.unitaryGroup (a × b) ℂ,
        {A | (APPT.Quantum.partialTranspose ((U : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ)*A*
          (U : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ)ᴴ)).PosSemidef} := by
    ext A; simp [APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT]
  rw [he]
  apply isClosed_iInter
  intro U
  exact Matrix.posSemidef_is_closed.preimage
    (continuous_partialTranspose.comp (by fun_prop))

theorem isClosed_density : IsClosed
    {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ | APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A} := by
  exact Matrix.posSemidef_is_closed.inter (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) continuous_const)

theorem continuous_quantum_purity : Continuous
    (APPT.Quantum.purity : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ → ℝ) := by
  unfold APPT.Quantum.purity
  fun_prop

/-- Hermitian purity is the sum of squared norms of the actual matrix entries. -/
theorem hermitian_purity_entry_squares {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    APPT.Quantum.purity A = ∑ i, ∑ j, ‖A i j‖^2 := by
  unfold APPT.Quantum.purity
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Complex.re_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  have hs : A j i=star (A i j) := by
    have he := congrArg (fun M => M j i) hA.eq
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply] using he.symm
  rw [hs, Complex.sq_norm]
  simp [Complex.mul_re, Complex.normSq_apply]

/-- Trace-one positivity bounds every complex entry, with no spectral ansatz. -/
theorem density_entry_norm_le_one {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ}
    (hρ : APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A) (i j : a × b) : ‖A i j‖≤1 := by
  have he := hermitian_purity_entry_squares hρ.1.isHermitian
  have hfirst : ‖A i j‖^2≤∑ k, ‖A i k‖^2 :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => sq_nonneg ‖A i k‖) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  have hsecond : (∑ k, ‖A i k‖^2)≤∑ l, ∑ k, ‖A l k‖^2 :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (fun l _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => sq_nonneg ‖A l k‖)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hu := (density_purity_unit_interval hρ).2
  rw [he] at hu
  have hn := norm_nonneg (A i j)
  nlinarith

/-- The physical density-matrix set is compact in the entrywise finite-dimensional topology. -/
theorem isCompact_density : IsCompact
    {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ | APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A} := by
  have hc : IsCompact {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ |
      ∀ i j, A i j ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1} :=
    isCompact_pi_infinite (fun _ => isCompact_pi_infinite (fun _ => isCompact_closedBall 0 1))
  apply hc.of_isClosed_subset isClosed_density
  intro A hA i j
  simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using density_entry_norm_le_one hA i j

/-- Compactness retains both positivity and all global-unitary PPT constraints. -/
theorem isCompact_density_appt : IsCompact
    {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ | APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A ∧ APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT A} :=
  isCompact_density.inter_right isClosed_absolutelyPPT

end APPTReview

import StateTopology

open scoped BigOperators ComplexOrder
open Matrix
namespace APPTReview
variable {a b : Type*} [Fintype a] [Fintype b] [DecidableEq a] [DecidableEq b]

/-- The entry-pair permutation implementing partial transposition in a trace-square sum. -/
def transposePairEquiv : ((a × b) × (a × b)) ≃ ((a × b) × (a × b)) where
  toFun p := ((p.2.1,p.1.2),(p.1.1,p.2.2))
  invFun p := ((p.2.1,p.1.2),(p.1.1,p.2.2))
  left_inv := by rintro ⟨⟨i,x⟩,⟨j,y⟩⟩; rfl
  right_inv := by rintro ⟨⟨i,x⟩,⟨j,y⟩⟩; rfl

/-- Partial transposition preserves the actual trace-square expression. -/
theorem partialTranspose_purity (A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ) :
    APPT.Quantum.purity (APPT.Quantum.partialTranspose A)=APPT.Quantum.purity A := by
  let f : ((a × b) × (a × b)) → ℝ := fun p => (A p.1 p.2*A p.2 p.1).re
  have he := (transposePairEquiv (a:=a) (b:=b)).sum_comp f
  simpa [APPT.Quantum.purity,Matrix.trace,Matrix.diag_apply,Matrix.mul_apply,
    Complex.re_sum,APPT.Quantum.partialTranspose,transposePairEquiv,f,Fintype.sum_prod_type] using he

/-- Transfer a proved bound on the actual ordered eigenvalues into matrix positivity. -/
theorem identity_sub_smul_posSemidef_of_spectral_cap
    {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (c : ℝ)
    (hcap : ∀ i, c*hA.eigenvalues₀ i≤1) :
    (1-c • A).PosSemidef := by
  let d : a × b → ℂ := fun i => (hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ)
  have hbound (i : a × b) : c*hA.eigenvalues i≤1 := by
    let j := (spectralLabel (a × b)).symm i
    have he := eigenvalues_spectralLabel hA j
    simp only [j,Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at he
    rw [he]
    exact hcap j
  have hdiag : (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (1:ℂ)-(c:ℂ)*d i)).PosSemidef := by
    apply Matrix.PosSemidef.diagonal
    intro i
    change (0:ℂ)≤1-(c:ℂ)*(hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ)
    exact_mod_cast (sub_nonneg.mpr (hbound i))
  have he : Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (1:ℂ)-(c:ℂ)*d i) =
      (1-c • Matrix.diagonal d : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ) := by
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i=j <;> simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply,Matrix.one_apply,hij,Complex.real_smul]
  rw [he] at hdiag
  have hp := hdiag.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same
    (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ)
  have hs := hA.spectral_theorem
  simp only [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply,RCLike.ofReal_eq_complex_ofReal,Function.comp_def] at hs
  simpa [d,Matrix.mul_sub,Matrix.sub_mul,Matrix.mul_smul,Matrix.smul_mul,
    ← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,Unitary.coe_mul_star_self,← hs] using hp

/-- An upper bound on a Hermitian trace-square gives a true operator upper bound. -/
theorem hermitian_one_sub_posSemidef_of_purity_le_one
    {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hp : APPT.Quantum.purity A≤1) : (1-A).PosSemidef := by
  have hs : (∑ i, (hA.eigenvalues₀ i)^2)≤1 := by
    rwa [purity_eq_ordered_eigenvalues hA] at hp
  have hc (i) : (1:ℝ)*hA.eigenvalues₀ i≤1 := by
    have hh := Finset.single_le_sum (fun j (_ : j∈Finset.univ) => sq_nonneg (hA.eigenvalues₀ j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    have hb := hh.trans hs
    nlinarith
  simpa using identity_sub_smul_posSemidef_of_spectral_cap hA 1 hc

/-- The partial transpose of every physical density matrix is bounded above by I. -/
theorem density_partialTranspose_upper
    {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ} (hρ : APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A) :
    (1-APPT.Quantum.partialTranspose A).PosSemidef := by
  apply hermitian_one_sub_posSemidef_of_purity_le_one
    (APPT.Quantum.partialTranspose_isHermitian hρ.1.isHermitian)
  rw [partialTranspose_purity]
  exact (density_purity_unit_interval hρ).2

/-- Complement-density sufficiency under EVERY global unitary, with no Schmidt assumption. -/
theorem one_sub_density_absolutelyPPT
    {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ} (hρ : APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A) :
    APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT (1-A) := by
  intro U
  have hp := density_partialTranspose_upper (APPT.Quantum.isDensity_unitaryConjugate hρ U)
  simpa [Matrix.mul_sub,Matrix.sub_mul,← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,
    Unitary.coe_mul_star_self] using hp

end APPTReview
files.DensityComplement.lean:
import TransposePurity

open scoped BigOperators ComplexOrder
open Matrix
namespace APPTReview
variable {a b : Type*} [Fintype a] [Fintype b] [DecidableEq a] [DecidableEq b]

noncomputable def complementDensity (A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ) :=
  (1/((Fintype.card (a × b):ℝ)-1)) • (1-A)

theorem complementDensity_isDensity
    (hD : 1<Fintype.card (a × b)) {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ}
    (hρ : APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A) : APPT.Quantum.IsDensity (complementDensity A) := by
  have hc : (0:ℝ)<(Fintype.card (a × b):ℝ)-1 := sub_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hD)
  constructor
  · exact (hermitian_one_sub_posSemidef_of_purity_le_one hρ.1.isHermitian
      (density_purity_unit_interval hρ).2).smul (by positivity)
  · have ht : (1-A).trace=(((Fintype.card (a × b):ℝ)-1):ℂ) := by
      simp [Matrix.trace_sub,Matrix.trace_one,hρ.2]
    simp only [complementDensity,Matrix.trace_smul,ht,Complex.real_smul]
    have he : (1/((Fintype.card (a × b):ℝ)-1))*((Fintype.card (a × b):ℝ)-1)=1 :=
      div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hc)
    have hh := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => (x:ℂ)) he
    simpa only [Complex.ofReal_mul,Complex.ofReal_sub,Complex.ofReal_one] using hh

theorem complementDensity_absolutelyPPT
    (hD : 1<Fintype.card (a × b)) {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ}
    (hρ : APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A) : APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT (complementDensity A) := by
  have hc : (0:ℝ)<(Fintype.card (a × b):ℝ)-1 := sub_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hD)
  exact APPT.Quantum.absolutelyPPT_smul (one_sub_density_absolutelyPPT hρ) (by positivity)

/-- Exact physical second moment of the normalized complement. -/
theorem complementDensity_purity {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ}
    (hρ : APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A) :
    APPT.Quantum.purity (complementDensity A) =
      ((Fintype.card (a × b):ℝ)-2+APPT.Quantum.purity A)/((Fintype.card (a × b):ℝ)-1)^2 := by
  have he : (1-A)*(1-A)=(1 : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ)-(2:ℝ) • A+A*A := by
    simp only [Matrix.mul_sub,Matrix.sub_mul,Matrix.one_mul,Matrix.mul_one]
    module
  unfold APPT.Quantum.purity complementDensity
  rw [Matrix.smul_mul,Matrix.mul_smul,he]
  simp only [Matrix.trace_smul,Matrix.trace_add,Matrix.trace_sub,Matrix.trace_one,hρ.2,
    Complex.smul_re,Complex.add_re,Complex.sub_re,Complex.one_re,Complex.natCast_re,smul_eq_mul]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv,inv_pow]
  ring

/-- Any trace-one PSD matrix below I/(D-1) is genuinely APPT.
This is a proved sufficiency implication, not an assumed spectral characterization. -/
theorem density_spectral_cap_absolutelyPPT
    (hD : 1<Fintype.card (a × b)) {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ}
    (hρ : APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A)
    (hcap : (1-((Fintype.card (a × b):ℝ)-1) • A).PosSemidef) :
    APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT A := by
  let c : ℝ := (Fintype.card (a × b):ℝ)-1
  have hc : 0<c := by dsimp [c]; exact sub_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hD)
  have hQ : APPT.Quantum.IsDensity (1-c • A) := by
    refine ⟨hcap,?_⟩
    simp [Matrix.trace_sub,Matrix.trace_smul,Matrix.trace_one,hρ.2,c,Complex.real_smul]
  have hp := APPT.Quantum.absolutelyPPT_smul (one_sub_density_absolutelyPPT hQ)
    (show (0:ℝ)≤1/c by positivity)
  have he : (1-(1-c • A))=c • A := by abel
  rw [he,smul_smul] at hp
  simpa [ne_of_gt hc] using hp

end APPTReview

import DensityComplement
import APPTReview.BoundarySpectrum
import APPTReview.ProjectionState

open scoped BigOperators ComplexOrder
open Matrix
namespace APPTReview

/-- Complete singular-state classification with the original all-unitary definition.
The converse is supplied by a proved complement-density quantum construction. -/
theorem density_singular_appt_iff_spectrum {m n : ℕ} (hm : 2≤m) (hmn : m≤n)
    {A : Matrix (Fin m × Fin n) (Fin m × Fin n) ℂ}
    (hρ : APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A) (hdet : A.det=0) :
    APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT A ↔
      ∀ i : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin m × Fin n)),
        hρ.1.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ i =
          if i.val=Fintype.card (Fin m × Fin n)-1 then 0
          else 1/((Fintype.card (Fin m × Fin n):ℝ)-1) := by
  constructor
  · intro ha; exact density_appt_singular_spectrum hm hmn hρ ha hdet
  · intro hs
    have hD : 1<Fintype.card (Fin m × Fin n) := by
      simp only [Fintype.card_prod,Fintype.card_fin]; nlinarith
    have hc : (Fintype.card (Fin m × Fin n):ℝ)-1≠0 :=
      ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hD))
    apply density_spectral_cap_absolutelyPPT hD hρ
    apply identity_sub_smul_posSemidef_of_spectral_cap hρ.1.isHermitian
    intro i
    rw [hs i]
    split_ifs <;> simp [hc]

/-- Every singular APPT density has exactly the one-hole purity. -/
theorem density_appt_singular_purity {m n : ℕ} (hm : 2≤m) (hmn : m≤n)
    {A : Matrix (Fin m × Fin n) (Fin m × Fin n) ℂ}
    (hρ : APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A) (ha : APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT A)
    (hdet : A.det=0) :
    APPT.Quantum.purity A=1/((m:ℝ)*n-1) := by
  have hs := density_appt_singular_spectrum hm hmn hρ ha hdet
  let c : ℝ := 1/((Fintype.card (Fin m × Fin n):ℝ)-1)
  have he (i) : (hρ.1.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ i)^2=c*hρ.1.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ i := by
    rw [hs i]
    split_ifs <;> dsimp [c] <;> ring
  rw [purity_eq_ordered_eigenvalues hρ.1.isHermitian]
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum,ordered_eigenvalues_sum hρ.1.isHermitian hρ.2,mul_one]
  simp [c]

/-- Actual singular APPT attainment in all rectangular dimensions 2<=m<=n.
The state is the normalized complement of a coordinate rank-one projection. -/
theorem exists_singular_appt_density {m n : ℕ} (hm : 2≤m) (hmn : m≤n) :
    ∃ A : Matrix (Fin m × Fin n) (Fin m × Fin n) ℂ,
      APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A ∧ APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT A ∧ A.det=0 ∧
      APPT.Quantum.purity A=1/((m:ℝ)*n-1) := by
  let p : Fin m × Fin n := (⟨0,by omega⟩,⟨0,by omega⟩)
  let Q : Matrix (Fin m × Fin n) (Fin m × Fin n) ℂ := setProjection {p}
  have hQh : Q.IsHermitian := setProjection_hermitian _
  have hQsq : Q*Q=Q := setProjection_sq _
  have hQtr : Q.trace=1 := by simp [Q,setProjection_trace]
  have hQ : APPT.Quantum.IsDensity Q :=
    ⟨hermitian_idempotent_posSemidef Q hQh hQsq,hQtr⟩
  have hD : 1<Fintype.card (Fin m × Fin n) := by
    simp only [Fintype.card_prod,Fintype.card_fin]; nlinarith
  have hd := complementDensity_isDensity hD hQ
  have ha := complementDensity_absolutelyPPT hD hQ
  have hdiag : complementDensity Q = Matrix.diagonal
      (fun i => if i=p then (0:ℂ) else ((1/((Fintype.card (Fin m × Fin n):ℝ)-1):ℝ):ℂ)) := by
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i=j <;> by_cases hip : i=p <;>
      simp [complementDensity,Q,setProjection,Matrix.diagonal_apply,Matrix.one_apply,
        hij,hip,Complex.real_smul]
  have hdet : (complementDensity Q).det=0 := by
    rw [hdiag,Matrix.det_diagonal]
    exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ p) (by simp)
  exact ⟨complementDensity Q,hd,ha,hdet,density_appt_singular_purity hm hmn hd ha hdet⟩

end APPTReview
